messages:
ria: Heads-up - we've got a spike of tiny pending pods in ap-southeast1 that are causing strange packing quantiles and a cascade of soft-evicts.
aj: saw the alert. which pool/instance types?
mike: short summary from the scheduler logs: lots of pods requesting fractional GPU with weird seqlen=8 bursts, packer keeps leaving 0.25 slots fragmented across racks.
sara: @ria any recent changes to the prebind or quantile heuristics? We rolled a tuning patch last week.
ria: rolled a small change to the 'quantile_threshold' -> 0.65 on Tuesday as part of packer-tune-1. It improved latin tests but looks like real traffic has more small-seq jobs.
jordan: paste of relevant logs:
```
2026-03-20T02:11:22Z packer: quantile=0.68 target=0.5 slot_left=0.25 pool=ase1-cpu-gpu
2026-03-20T02:11:23Z scheduler: prebind-skip pod=embedder-xyz reason=fuzzy-fit
2026-03-20T02:11:24Z node: evict soft pod=batch-worker-12 reason=fragmentation
```
aj: hmm fuzzy-fit prebind skips -> leads to many 0.25 remainders. Those tiny leftovers can't be reused due to affinity on nvlink labels.
mike: can we temporarily lower quantile_threshold to 0.5 in ap-southeast1 only? Or set a fallback to prefer coalesce for seqlen<16?
sara: patching region-specific tunables is fine as mitigation. Need rollout plan: short TTL and revert if tail-latency regresses.
ria: I'll open a canary config: set quantile_threshold=0.5 for pool ase1-gpu-small with a 30m ramp. rebalancer-bot will notify when >10% pod pending persists.
rebalancer-bot: scheduled rollout: pool=ase1-gpu-small set quantile_threshold=0.5 -> start=2026-03-20T03:00Z ttl=30m
jordan: also saw network attach delays to a subset of nodes (conntrack backlog) around same window — might be compounding placement failures.
aj: good catch. if attach latency >1s we skip affinity coalesce which amplifies fragmentation. Ops, can we bump node conntrack and egress window in that AZ?
mike: ops A-team, quick ask: bump conntrack to 262144 on ase1b nodes and re-run warm-pool sync. I'll monitor packer metrics.
sara: agreed. plan: (1) deploy quantile_tweak to pool (2) bump conntrack on ase1b (3) watch pending ratio + evict counts for 1h. If evicts drop -> keep; else revert.
ria: starting canary now, tagging owners: @aj @mike @sara. Will post progress in this thread :rocket:
aj: thanks, will watch. If we still see 0.25 leftovers after canary, let's consider a quick coalescer pass that treats fractional slots <0.5 as mergable for small-seq workloads.
mike: logging dashboard queries:
- pending ratio: `sum(pending_pods{pool=\"ase1-gpu-small\"}) / sum(total_pods{pool=\"ase1-gpu-small\"})`
- fragment histogram: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(slot_left_bucket[5m])) by (le))`
sara: will add an alert if pending ratio > 8% for 15m post-rollout.
rebalancer-bot: canary started. will report in 5m.
ria: thanks everyone. follow-up after 30m with results.
